_comment: Where the compilers and suite checkouts live.
Values may use $VAR, ${VAR} and ~, so this file can be shared between
A toolchain is either {'cc': '/path/to/gcc'} for an installed compiler,
or {'build_dir': '.../build/gcc'} for an uninstalled build, which is
driven as `xgcc -B<build_dir>/`.  'src_dir' is optional and recorded
for provenance.  'extra_args' and 'env' are appended if present.
A suite entry's key names it in reports.  The adapter defaults to
that key; set 'adapter' explicitly to configure one adapter twice,
e.g. two BenchProctor releases side by side:
`gab run -s all` runs every suite listed here, writing a parent
directory with one ordinary run directory per suite.
